content_html:
Is it your last day in Cusco and you’re not sure what to do without rushing against the clock? Relax — even if you’ve already visited Machu Picchu and completed the main tours, there are still plenty of ways to enjoy Cusco before departure.

In this article, you’ll discover the best activities, ideal places, and practical tips to make the most of your final day — even if you have luggage to store or a late-night flight.

Best Activities for Your Last Day in Cusco

1. Stroll Through the Historic Center at a Relaxed Pace

Cusco’s historic center is perfect for a peaceful final walk. Wander around the Plaza de Armas, sit down for a coffee, or simply observe local life one last time.

Tip: Go early in the morning to avoid crowds and enjoy a quieter atmosphere.

2. Visit San Pedro Market

If you want to buy souvenirs, taste local food, or experience a more authentic side of Cusco, San Pedro Market is a must.

Here you’ll find:

  • Fresh natural juices
  • Andean cheeses
  • Affordable souvenirs
  • Traditional Peruvian dishes

Perfect if you’re short on time and want everything in one place.

3. Short, Centrally Located Museums

On your last day, choose small and centrally located museums that don’t require hours of exploration, such as:

  • Museo Inka
  • Museo de Arte Precolombino
  • Museo del Chocolate (fun and interactive)

They don’t take much time but greatly enrich your cultural experience.

4. Nearby Viewpoints for Final Photos

If you still have some energy, head to one of the nearby viewpoints for unforgettable farewell photos:

  • San Blas viewpoint
  • Cristo Blanco
  • Partial views of Sacsayhuamán

Ideal for beautiful city views without committing to a full-day tour.

5. Relaxing Massage or Spa Before Your Flight

After several days of walking and high-altitude adventures, a relaxing massage or spa session is a wonderful way to close your trip.

You’ll find many options in the Historic Center and the San Blas district.

Easy & Convenient Areas to Spend Your Last Hours

  • San Blas neighborhood
  • Cafés overlooking Plaza de Armas
  • Artisan shops in the city center
  • Restaurants offering quick tourist menus

Everything is within walking distance or a short taxi ride.

Useful Tips for Your Last Day in Cusco

Store your luggage
Most hotels and hostels offer free luggage storage after check-out.

Avoid long tours
It’s not recommended to visit the Sacred Valley or Rainbow Mountain on your departure day.

Plan airport transfer time wisely
Leave for the airport early, especially during peak traffic hours.

Buy souvenirs on your last day
That way you won’t carry them throughout your entire trip.

Eat light if flying the same day
Especially helpful after days at high altitude.

A Calm and Memorable Farewell

Your last day in Cusco doesn’t have to feel rushed or stressful. With a light, well-located, and realistic plan, you can close your journey with calm moments, great photos, and a meaningful final experience.

Cusco doesn’t say goodbye in a hurry — it does so with one last peaceful walk and a good cup of coffee
